objectives.name: Establish situation before choice
objectives.acceptance: Arrival and approach lead into active inspection of a persistent world before any bearing can be committed.

objectives.name: Create actual deliberation
objectives.acceptance: Every bearing exposes a distinct ungraded tradeoff preview, and the visitor may compare previews before an explicit commit.

objectives.name: World reacts before prose explains
objectives.acceptance: Commit enters a branch-specific world-response state with multiple spatial changes before continuation or reflection.

objectives.name: Preserve one continuous world
objectives.acceptance: Stable world-shell landmarks persist while state attributes transform geometry, route, light, marker, and viewpoint.

objectives.name: Reduce styled Web-demo framing
objectives.acceptance: A full-viewport landscape is the primary interface; contextual text and semantic controls remain lightweight overlays rather than a dominant card.

interactionModel: Arrive at the edge of one continuous crossing.
Approach the marker through an enacted world action.
Inspect ridge, marker, and gap cues using semantic in-world controls.
Compare concise tradeoff previews without revealing consequences or endings.
Explicitly commit the currently previewed bearing.
Perceive an immediate branch-specific transformation of the persistent world.
Read the reflection and optionally restart.

edge.tradeoffPreview: Wind cover and a readable bend are exchanged for a shortened view beyond the ridge.
edge.geometryState: The near ridge grows dominant and compresses the visible sky aperture.
edge.routeRelationship: The route bends laterally along the boundary.
edge.markerRelationship: The marker remains large and spatially near behind the bend.
edge.environmentalState: Wind falls and the field becomes close, sheltered, and partially occluded.

wait.tradeoffPreview: Remaining still costs distance while changing light may reveal information at the marker.
wait.geometryState: The viewpoint remains fixed while light, shadow, and a previously occluded cross-route change around it.
wait.routeRelationship: A transverse route becomes legible instead of forward travel.
wait.markerRelationship: The marker and traveler remain fixed as the marker shadow rotates.
wait.environmentalState: Light lowers; the world moves while the visitor remains still and watchful.

gap.tradeoffPreview: A direct open line offers visibility and speed without wind cover or a close boundary.
gap.geometryState: Horizon banks separate, the sky aperture widens, and protective forms recede.
gap.routeRelationship: The route extends deep and directly through exposed ground.
gap.markerRelationship: The marker visibly shrinks and recedes behind the traveler.
gap.environmentalState: Wind lines cross a wide, exposed field with a distant destination held in view.

continuityRequirements: The world shell and key SVG landmark elements persist from survey through deliberation, response, and continuation.
State changes are represented through attributes and authored transforms rather than root-scene replacement.
Reduced motion exposes the same before and after geometry immediately without hiding semantic state.
